title: The Model Bridge of Sticks
youtube_title: The Model Bridge of Sticks | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is letting each person keep the part they do best.
summary: At a bakery kitchen before the early table, a model bridge that stood only when both sides were held and then not will go wrong if one person rushes. Uma and Yael split it into two slow jobs, while Ms. Okonkwo only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
